owner.current_income_note: owner's current income not entered: asking rent used as the comparison

operator.excludes_note_for_simple_payback: The simple payback excludes the conversion period, any payments to the owner during it, the fill ramp and pre-opening costs. The full-timeline figures include them.

needs_input: operating model (N as a function of occupancy)

flags.text: profit share with no minimum payment: the owner receives nothing during consent, works, audit and fill

retrofit_recovery_first.note: shown beside the default treatment; the switch is off by default

jv.note_net_definition: Net operating profit shared = revenue minus food, staffing (with roster coverage), clinical lead and manager, utilities, insurance, compliance and certification, supplies, repairs and maintenance and other agreed operating costs, before the JV share.

assumptions: N is the weekly net operating profit at the stabilised occupancy; below that it is scaled in proportion to occupancy, which flatters low occupancy because staffing is fixed.
Downside cases: occupancy 60%, and N lower by 30%.
Weeks per year = 52. Projections are illustrative and may be wrong.
Conversion period = 16 weeks (consent 4, works 8, audit and sign-off 4).
stabilised_only.banner: Lawyer review required. Illustrative projections from the stated assumptions; no outcome is promised.
stabilised_only.legal_flags: A profit share or JV can change legal, tax, liability, lender and insurer treatment. Questions for a lawyer and an accountant: lease with a profit-share rent, a JV entity, or a management agreement; the operator must be the certified legal entity; the owner's lender and insurer may need to consent. This tool recommends no structure.
